prompt.positive: Continue this exact 16:9 first-person live-action Rongguo gate image as one restrained continuous period-drama shot at cold early dawn. Lin Daiyu's pale-blue sedan and its attendants move naturally deeper through the open gate while the indigo-robed gate attendant at frame right takes one controlled half-step toward the unseen player, lowers his raised stopping hand, and looks down to inspect a recommendation letter held just below frame. A messenger inside pauses and turns to receive the report. Preserve the gate, stone steps, courtyard depth, costume, sedan, cold dawn light and sparse warm lanterns. Camera remains at the unseen player's eye level with only subtle breathing and no third-person reveal. The final three seconds settle into a stable waiting composition for a choice. Silent clean picture plate only; all locked Mandarin dialogue will be added as independent stems.
